name: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse
description: Mickey and his friends Minnie, Donald, Pluto, Daisy, Goofy, Pete, Clarabelle and more go on fun and educational adventures.

videos.title: Mickey's Adventures in Wonderland
videos.overview: Don't be late for a very important date: Daisy's surprise birthday party!  Her present is a magical cuckoo clock, and when the cuckoo bird flies away, Mickey and Donald set off through a fairytale wonderland to find him.  Will they choose the right mouseketools to locate Cuckoo and get home in time?

videos.title: The Wizard of Dizz (2)
videos.overview:
Part 2 of the extended episode The Wizard of Dizz!

Minnie travels with her friends to see the Wizard of the Pink Crystal City

videos.title: Big Splash
videos.overview: Aloha, Everybody! Ready for waves of laughter and adventure? Then put on your floaties, grab your boogie boards and jump in! It's the hottest day of the year -- even Goofy's chicken noodle ice cream cone has melted into soup! So Mickey and his pals are cooling off at Star Lake. Pete's hosting a Hawaiian luau, and it just might be the best beach bash ever, but only if YOU can help the gang pick the right mousketools to get the party started. You'll ride a tide of fun with Mickey as you reel in a big, red Gooey fish, float above the clouds with Pluto in a giant soap bubble and help Donald rescue a flock of lost ducks. Filled with tons of music, excitement and magical surprises, MICKEY'S BIG SPLASH will make you shout, "Mouseka-bunga!"

videos.title: Storybook Surprises
videos.overview: Mickey Mouse returns for another fun-filled collection of stories in a volume that's fun for all the family.

videos.title: Minnie's Bow-Tique
videos.overview: Welcome to the grand opening of Minnie's sparkling-new store, packed with the coolest bows and bow ties you've ever seen! Watch as Daisy's amazing mood bow magically changes colors. Say Cheese and smile for Donald's camera bow tie, and help catch a bunch of runaway butterfly bows. It looks like there's something here for everyone...But Pete has a problem: He wants to get a present for his Aunt Mabel, and he's never shopped for ladies' bows before. He'll need a lot of help from Minnie, Toodles and YOU to find the perfect gift. Then, join your Clubhouse pals for a daytime sleepover, a picnic in Mickey Park and more exciting adventures.

videos.title: A Valentine Surprise For Minnie
videos.overview: Join Mickey, Minnie and the gang as they enjoy the most romantic day of the year, in this great CLUBHOUSE adventure.

videos.title: Mickey's Great Outdoors
videos.overview: Join Mickey, Donald and the gang for laughter, surprises and blue skies! Everyone's excited because today is the big Clubhouse Camp Out. Help your pals pick the right Mouseketools so they can pitch their tents, catch gooey fish on Circle Lake and earn their camping badges. Then, set out with Mickey and Minnie on a jungle safari as they seek out a rare flower.

videos.title: Donald And The Baby Sheep
videos.overview: Donald goes for a nice walk down in the lower park and comes across a cute baby sheep.

videos.title: Choo Choo Express
videos.overview: Join Mickey, Toodles and the Gang for this magical full-length adventure you ll enjoy year-round! Ride the amazing Clubhouse Train to the top of the mountain, and help load the cars full of incredible, never-melting, Easy-Freezey snow! Share in the excitement when you arrive back at the Clubhouse to ski and make snow angels ...

videos.title: Mickey's Great Outdoors
videos.overview: Join Mickey, Donald and the gang for laughter, surprises and blue skies! Everyone's excited, because today is the big Clubhouse Camp Out. Help your pals pick the right Mouseketools so they can pitch their tents, catch gooey fish on Circle Lake and earn their camping badges. Then, get ready for adventure and exploration as Mickey and Minnie set off on a jungle safari in search of a rare, legendary flower. There's always a world of fun under the sun in "Mickey's Great Outdoors".

videos.title: Mini is looking for a kitten
Minnie wants to arrange a parade
Mickey's Train Station
videos.overview: Engineer Mickey is on a schedule to pick up his friends at the Choo-Choo train stations.

videos.title: Numbers Roundup
videos.overview: Rustle Up Some Fun! Howdy Mousekeroos! It’s time to put on your cowboy hats, grab your lassos and help Mickey, Goofy and all your Clubhouse pals wrangle a boisterous herd of wild numbers into Mickey Corral. Laugh it up as you count ‘em down from 10 to 1, and rustle up the right Mouseketools to catch those rascally numbers! Then search for Daisy Bo Peep’s lost sheep, decode a secret message, and solve more super fun puzzles.

videos.title: Mickey's Monster Musical
videos.overview: Put on your favorite Halloween costume and get set for a spooktacular full-length adventure! Visit the creaky castle of kindly "Count Mickula" and help your Clubhouse pals solve a puzzling riddle: Who, or what, is making a curious clanging, banging noise? With the right Monster Mouseketools and help from YOU, this mystery will soon be history! Then, enjoy two more exciting episodes as you search for pirate treasure with Captain Mickey and don your dungarees for delightful fun down on the farm. Packed with singing, dancing, laughter and surprises, MICKEY'S MONSTER MUSICAL is a high-spirited treat that can't be beat!

videos.title: Minnie-s Bee Story
videos.overview: A strong wind has blown Buzz-Buzz the Bee away from his sunflower!

videos.title: Daisy Bo Peep

videos.overview: The gang prepares a special secret surprise for Minnie Mouse which makes her day.

videos.title: Goofy's Bird
videos.overview: There is much excitement when Goofy gets a cute pet bird.

videos.title: Donald's Big Balloon Race
videos.overview: The gang is bored so Donald comes up with a creative idea with a big balloon race!

videos.title: Donald and the Beanstalk
videos.overview: Donald runs in to a beanstalk and some weird thing take place.

videos.title: Mickey Goes Fishing
videos.overview: Goofy leaves his pet kitten, Mr. Pettibone, with Mickey, but Mr. Pettibone only eats big red gooey fish.

videos.title: Donald the Frog Prince
videos.overview: Donald turns into a frog prince.

videos.title: Minnie's Birthday
videos.overview: The group of friends celebrate Minnie's birthday and there are more surprises coming her way.

videos.title: Goofy on Mars
videos.overview: Goofy travels all the way to Mars.

videos.title: Mickey-Go-Seek
videos.overview: Mickey plays hide and seek with his friends but when Mickey hides really well, everyone gets worried about him

videos.title: Daisy's Dance
videos.overview: While attending a dance, Daisy gets stage fright when it is time for her to perform.

videos.title: Pluto's Ball
videos.overview: Pluto is outside playing with his favorite ball, when he bounces it a little too high and it rolls away. Mickey and Pluto set out to save the day and find the lost ball.

videos.title: Mickey's Treasure Hunt
videos.overview: Mickey believes that there is treasure somewhere and convinces all of his friends to search for it.

videos.title: Daisy in the Sky
videos.overview: Daisy, Pluto and Minnie are carried away by a bunch of balloons.

videos.title: Pluto's Puppy-sitting Adventure
videos.overview: Pluto starts baby-sitting Clarabelle Cow's puppies and soon realizes that they aren't as easy to watch as he thought they would be.

videos.title: Pluto's Best
videos.overview: Pluto and Butch, Pete's dog, compete for a trophy by playing a variety of games.

videos.title: Mickey's Treat
videos.overview: It's Halloween for Mickey and the gang and they get an invitation to go to Pete's Halloween Party located at the Trick-or-Treat Tower.

videos.title: Minnie Red Riding Hood
videos.overview: Minnie Mouse goes out into the woods and ventures across some trouble. Will her friends save the day?

videos.title: Sleeping Minnie
videos.overview: Minnie picks a magic rose that puts a curse on her that makes her sleep for 100 years if the spell is not broken.

videos.title: Mickey Saves Santa
videos.overview: Mickey and Donald run to save Santa Claus so that he can deliver the presents to everyone, otherwise there will be no Christmas.

videos.title: Goofy the Great
videos.overview: Goofy is performing in a magic show, but things start to go wrong right before the show is set to begin.

videos.title: Mickey's Color Adventure
videos.overview: Mickey's special Rainbow Color Machine runs into a problem when it starts to run out of color.

videos.title: Goofy's Petting Zoo
videos.overview: Goofy gets a job at the local petting zoo and falls asleep allowing the animals to escape. Goofy calls his pal Mickey to help him find the missing animals.

videos.title: Doctor Daisy, M.D.
videos.overview: Daisy acts as the doctor when Donald gets sick.

videos.title: Donald's Lost Lion
videos.overview: Donald can't find his favorite stuffed lion that he wants before bedtime. Mickey volunteers to help him find it.

videos.title: Donald's Hiccups
videos.overview: Donald gets a bad case of the hiccups. Daisy, Mickey, Goofy and Pluto all try to help him, but end up getting the hiccups themselves.

videos.title: Fancy Dancin' Goofy
videos.overview: When Clarabelle invites Goofy to go with her to the Fancy Dance, the gang helps him learn gentlemanly ways.

videos.title: Goofy the Home Maker
videos.overview: Goofy and the gang construct a birdhouse for Baby Red Bird and his family

videos.title: Mickey’s Handy Helpers
videos.overview: When the handy Helpers break down, Mickey and the gang work to fix them.

videos.title: Goofy Baby
videos.overview: When Professor Ludwig Von Drake's Time Machine turns Goofy into a baby, Mickey and the gang must babysit Goofy Baby until the machine is fixed.

videos.title: Minnie's Picnic
videos.overview: Minnie decides to memorialize the new picnic area of the clubhouse by organizing the first picnic with the help of her friends.

videos.title: Goofy in Training
videos.overview: Goofy tries to run an obstacle course and gets help from his friends. Goofy is practicing for the Mickey Mouse Obstacle Course in hopes of winning a medal.

videos.title: Mickey's Big Band Concert
videos.overview: Mickey and friends practice their band's music for the Mickey Park Polka-Palooza Dance Festival where the elephants will dance the Pachyderm Polka.

videos.title: Goofy's Hat
videos.overview: Today is the Clubhouse's "Picture Day," where all of the Mickey Mouse Clubhouse friends get their picture taken. But it seems that Goofy is too disappointed to take his picture because he lost his hat.

videos.title: Donald's Special Delivery
videos.overview: The Clubhouse mail has arrived for all of the Clubhouse friends except Donald. It's up to the Clubhouse friends all make Donald feel better.

videos.title: Daisy's Pet Project
videos.overview: Daisy has trouble finding a pet for the Pet Parade. She must find a pet before the Pet Parade starts. She gets three pets, an elephant named Bubbles, a giraffe named Longfellow and a bunny named Captain Jumps-a-Lot.

videos.title: Clarabelle's Clubhouse Carnival
videos.overview: With Mickey and friends' help, Clarabelle sets up a carnival at the Clubhouse grounds. The reason for it is her need to feed the chickens with lots of corn.

videos.title: Mickey and Minnie's Jungle Safari
videos.overview: Minnie wants to have a picture of a hula hibiscus to complete her flower picture collection, but she has only one day to get it, when it is in full bloom. She will need help from all of her Clubhouse friends to get to where the flower is located.

videos.title: Mickey's Art Show
videos.overview: Goofy learns to sculpt, paint and draw so he can compete in an arts-and-crafts show sponsored by Mickey.

videos.title: Mickey's Camp Out
videos.overview: Mickey and the rest of the Clubhouse friends have a \"Big Clubhouse Camp Out. They are trying to earn a Clubhouse Camp Out badge for each one of them by doing two tasks at a campsite.

videos.title: Mickey's Round Up
videos.overview: Ludwig Von Drake's package of wild numbers has arrived at the Clubhouse. However, they are accidentally let out and it is up to Mickey and his Clubhouse friends to don cowboy/cowgirl clothes and gear and round them all up to the "MickeyCorral" on the grounds before the Professor returns from an errand. Note: This is the only time something is alive.

videos.title: Mickey's Big Job
videos.overview: Mickey and the gang take care of Willie the Giant's farm while he's away.

videos.title: Pluto's Bubble Bath
videos.overview: Clarabelle and Bella are coming over for tea and biscuits and dog biscuits and Pluto is all dirty and needs a bubble bath. But when Pluto's bubble bath gets out of hand, Mickey and Pluto each get stuck inside a giant bubble and float away from the clubhouse.

videos.title: Mickey's Silly Problem
videos.overview: The clubhouse's "silly switch" gets stuck and makes everyone act in comical ways, such as Mickey only speaking in rhyme and Pluto making every animal sound except barking.

videos.title: Mickey's Thanks A Bunch Day
videos.overview: Minnie uses a growth spray in her garden to help her fruits and vegetables grow in time to be picked for Thanks A Bunch Day, but it turns them all into gigantic creations.

videos.title: Secret Spy Daisy
videos.overview: Daisy protects Clarabelle's secret recipe for oatmeal raisin cookies from Pete.

videos.title: Pluto to the Rescue
videos.overview: Pluto comes to the rescue when Donald and Goofy build a snowman so big, they can't climb around it or over it.

videos.title: Sir Goofs-a-Lot
videos.overview: Goofy wants to be knighted by Queen Clarabelle, so he proves his bravery by going on a quest to retrieve three items.

videos.title: Minnie's Mystery
videos.overview: Minnie attempts to find out who took her fresh baked muffins from the clubhouse.

videos.title: Mickey's Comet
videos.overview: Everyone wants to view Mickey's Comet, but first they have to find Professor Von Drake and his telescope. This was the second episode in the series, following 'Doctor Daisy, M.D.', that the 'Mystery Mousketool' was chosen first.

videos.title: Clarabelle's Clubhouse Mooo-sical
videos.overview: Clarabelle stages a musical about nursery rhymes starring chickens from the petting zoo, but they practice so much, they lose their voices.

videos.title: Minnie's Rainbow
videos.overview: Minnie searches for a pot of gold and meets a leprechaun after a rainbow appears over the clubhouse.

videos.title: Space Captain Donald
videos.overview: Donald leads the gang on a mission to the moon to retrieve Pluto's bouncy ball.

videos.title: The Friendship Team
videos.overview: Help Detective Minnie and Secret Spy Daisy search for missing party hats for the clubhouse's Friendship Day celebration.

videos.title: Mickey's Message from Mars
videos.overview: Mickey, Daisy, Goofy and Pluto fly up to Mars and help a Martian Mickey find a secret treasure.\n\nGuests - Ludwig Von Drake, Pete, Martian Mickey and Pluto from Pluto.

videos.title: Pete's Beach Blanket Luau
videos.overview: Mickey and his friends throw a beach party to cool off on the hottest day of the year and Pete invites everyone.

videos.title: Minnie's Bee Story
videos.overview: A strong wind has blown Buzz-Buzz the Bee away from his sunflower!

videos.title: Pluto's Playmate
videos.overview: Mickey and his friends help Salty the Seal do tricks for the circus.

videos.title: Donald's Ducks
videos.overview: Donald helps a group of ducks get to a warm beach for their winter retreat.

videos.title: Goofy's Coconutty Monkey
videos.overview: When Goofy's friend Coco the Monkey can't find any coconuts for her "coconutty party," Goofy, Mickey and the clubhouse gang take a trip into the jungle in search of coconuts.

videos.title: Choo-Choo Express
videos.overview: Mickey and the gang build a train, so they can carry the professor's non-melting snow to the Clubhouse.

videos.title: Mickey and the Enchanted Egg
videos.overview: A story Mickey plans to read aloud about an enchanted egg, suddenly becomes real. The big purple dragon egg Wizard Pete is taking care of, rolls out of the castle and into Donald and Goofy while they are walking to the Clubhouse. A purple baby dragon pops out of the egg. Mickey and friends name it Zoe and take it to Wizard Pete, while trying to get out of his traps.

videos.title: Goofy Goes Goofy
videos.overview: Goofy gets cloned after Professor von Drake's new experimental Gooey-Goo splashes onto him. Mickey and his friends must take care of the clones until the effect wears off.

videos.title: Goofy's Super Wish
videos.overview: Goofy trains to be a superhero and uses his skills after Clarabelle's moo-muffin maker breaks.

videos.title: Mickey's Big Surprise
videos.overview: Help Mickey and his friends solve the five Fun Puzzles to get a Big Surprise.

videos.title: Goofy's Goofbot
videos.overview: Goofy constructs a robot in his own likeness.

videos.title: Mickey's Springtime Surprise
videos.overview: Mickey and Minnie kick off the first day of spring with an egg hunt.

videos.title: Super Goof's Super Puzzle
videos.overview: Goofy becomes Super Goof to solve some puzzles laid out by Pete.

videos.title: Donald of the Desert
videos.overview: The Clubhouse's sandbox is empty, so Donald leads the gang into the desert to get more sand. But they stumble across much more than that.

videos.title: Happy Birthday Toodles
videos.overview: It is Toodles' birthday and the whole gang is there to celebrate.

videos.title: Goofy's Magical Mix-Up
videos.overview: When Goofy The Great makes Pluto's dog house disappear, it's up to Mickey and the gang to find it.

videos.title: Pluto's Dinosaur Romp
videos.overview: The Professor accidentally brings back a baby dinosaur while using his time machine.

videos.title: Minnie's Pajama Party
videos.overview: Minnie throws a pajama party for all her friends.

videos.title: Road Rally
videos.overview: Mickey and his pals participate in a road rally that takes them across sandy deserts, over snow-covered mountains and through lush jungles.

videos.title: Donald the Genie
videos.overview: Pete The Genie gives Donald genie powers so that he can make his friend's wishes come true

videos.title: Daisy's Grasshopper
videos.overview: Mickey and the gang have to find Daisy's pet grasshopper Wilbur so that the Professor can take his picture for Grasshopper Day.

videos.title: Mickey's Mousekersize
videos.overview: Mickey and the gang help Pete get in shape by Mousekersizing.

videos.title: Mickey's Little Parade
videos.overview: Mickey and his pals search for three wind-up toy musicians after they run about due to being wound too tight just before a parade appearance.

videos.title: Minnie's Mouseke-Calendar
videos.overview: When the pages of Minnie's calendar blow away, it's up to the gang to help her get them back.

videos.title: Pluto Lends a Paw
videos.overview: Minnie loses her cat, Figaro, who makes a big mess after she makes a surprise for him. Pluto and Mickey pitch in to help track down Minnie's cat.

videos.title: Minnie's Bow-tique
videos.overview: Minnie opens a boutique filled with a variety of bows and bow ties.

videos.title: Minnie's Masquerade
videos.overview: Minnie decides to have a masquerade ball.

videos.overview: Goofy goes on a quest for a magical elixir to cure Willie The Giant's tummy ache.

videos.title: Donald's Clubhouse
videos.overview: Mickey leaves Donald in charge of the clubhouse and it quickly turns into a disaster area when he and Goofy make a huge mess just before Mother Goose Clarabelle is to visit.

videos.title: Mickey's Show and Tell
videos.overview: Martian Mickey visits the clubhouse for a show-and-tell presentation.

videos.title: Mickey's Fishy Story
videos.overview: Minne and Daisy arrive at the clubhouse with Goldie the goldfish. However, Goldie is all alone and has no one to swim with so Daisy and Minnie decide take Goldie to the waterfall in the jungle to find a friend.

videos.title: Space Adventure
videos.overview: Mickey, Minnie, Donald, Daisy, Goofy and Pluto blast off to outer space.

videos.overview: Goofy has mysteriously disappeared and it's up to The Go-Getters to find him.

videos.title: Goofy Babysitter
videos.overview: Goofy babysits when Mickey and his pals are accidentally turned into toddlers by a time machine.

videos.title: Pluto's Tale
videos.overview: Pluto becomes a brave prince in a fairy tale who tries to rescue princess Bella while watching out for Wizard Pete and his magic tricks.

videos.title: Goofy's Thinking Cap
videos.overview: Goofy uses a special Thinking Cap to solve Clarabelle Cow's Scavenger Hunt!

videos.title: Minnie and Daisy's Flower Shower
videos.overview: Minnie and Daisy host a flower show for their friends.

videos.title: Prince Pete's Catnap
videos.overview: Prince Pete needs a nap but cannot fall asleep.

videos.overview: Donald cares for a lost egg, while his friends search for its family.

videos.title: The Golden Boo Boo
videos.overview: Mickey and Daisy are dressed as detectives and, with the help of Minnie, Donald, Ludwig Von Drake, Goofy and Clarabelle, are on a mission to search for the golden statue of Boo Boo Chicken, before Pete gets to it first.

videos.overview: Mickey and his pals plan to rescue the missing animals from the Clubhouse Farm.

videos.title: Quest for the Crystal Mickey
videos.overview: Pete snatches the Crystal Mickey statue from the clubhouse.

videos.title: Daisy's Pony Tale
videos.overview: A new invention makes Daisy's ponytail grow long.

videos.title: Mickey's Farm Fun-Fair
videos.overview: MIckey and pals hold a farm fun fair.

videos.title: The Wizard of Dizz
videos.overview: Minnie and Pluto are swept up in a big wind and end up in the wonderful world of Dizz. And they need to get back to the clubhouse for the "Clubhouse Day" party.

videos.title: Super Adventure
videos.overview: Super Mickey and the Clubhouse Heroes must work as a team.

videos.title: Mickey's Mystery
videos.overview: Kansas City Mickey returns to help the clubhouse team solve a mystery in the Hidden Jungle.

videos.title: Minnie's Pet Salon
videos.overview: It's time for Pluto's All-Star Pet Show at Minnie's Pet Salon.

videos.title: Minnie-rella
videos.overview: Minnie has a dream that she is Minnierella.

videos.title: Mickey's Clubhouse Rocks
videos.overview: Mickey and the gang are prepared to rock with a battle-of-the-bands showdown filled with epic guitar solos.

videos.title: Donald Jr.
videos.overview: Donald teaches a duckling a dance for a school talent day.

videos.title: Sea Captain Mickey
videos.overview: Mickey and the gang search for something at the bottom of Mickey Lake. Mickey and the gang use a submarine to explore Mickey Lake, when Professor Von Drake's sonar-detecting machine discovers that there's something big at the bottom.

videos.title: Mickey's Pirate Adventure
videos.overview: Mickey and pals are enjoying a day at the beach when Peg Leg Pete delivers a note from Goofy’s long lost Grandpappy, Captain Goof-Beard, asking for the gang’s help in ensuring that Harmony-Chord Island, the musical isle where Goof-Beard lives, doesn’t go completely out of tune and sink.

videos.title: Mickey's Happy Mousekeday
videos.overview: It's Mickey's birthday, and for his birthday present, the Clubhouse gang has organized fun activities for the big Mousekeday.

videos.title: Minnie's Winter Bow Show
videos.overview: While putting together the Winter Bow Show, Minnie and her nieces, Millie and Melody get swept away to the Clubhouse North Pole.

videos.title: Around the Clubhouse World
videos.overview: Mickey, Minnie, and Pluto travel around the world to collect stamps for their special Clubhouse Passport.

videos.title: Mickey's Mousekeball
videos.overview: Professor Von Drake shows the Clubhouse pals a high-tech new game, Floatin' Fun-Time Mousekeball! But when the ball escapes, the game takes to the skies!

videos.title: Donald's Brand New Clubhouse
videos.overview: Donald complains everyone is in his way. So Mickey and his friends help Donald to build his own clubhouse.

videos.title: Mickey's Mousekedoer Adventure
videos.overview: Mousekedoer malfunctions and needs to be fixed.

videos.title: Mickey's Monster Musical
videos.overview: Mickey, Minnie and Pluto stumble upon Count Mikula's castle and help solve the mystery of its creaky noises.

videos.title: Pop Star Minnie!
videos.overview: When Minnie is invited to sing at Mistletoe Mountain, Mickey discovers that all the instruments are missing.

videos.title: Chef Goofy on the Go
videos.overview: Mickey helps Goofy serve up deliveries from his "Chef Goofy On the Go" lunch truck.

videos.title: Oh, Toodles!
videos.overview: Professor Von Drake is working on a surprise invention when he discovers that he is missing four of his tools. Toodles helps Mickey find them with Mouseketools and a checklist.

videos.title: Mickey's Sport-Y-Thon
videos.overview: Put on your sneakers, sports fans! Today is the first ever Mickey Mouse Sport-a-thon! It's an action-filled sports tournament that draws athletes from around the Clubhouse.

videos.title: Martian Minnie's Tea Party
videos.overview: Minnie's on her way to Mars on an urgent mission! Her assignment? Help her outer space twin, Martian Minnie, host a tea party for our Clubhouse friends throughout the galaxy!

videos.title: A Goofy Fairy Tale
videos.overview: It's bedtime at the Clubhouse and everyone's ready for their favorite bedtime stories! Unfortunately, Goofy's magic trick makes all the stories disappear from the Clubhouse books!
